messages.subject: Your account of 14 January - draft statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Derek,

Thank you for your time. I've drafted your witness statement covering your role, the machine, what you did on the day and the maintenance position. Please read it carefully - it must be in your own words and accurate. Of particular importance is paragraph 5 on the missed October test; please confirm you're comfortable it's a fair account. We can adjust before you sign.

Elena Marchetti

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Thank you. It reads accurately. On paragraph 5 - yes, I accept the October test wasn't done and that I didn't pick it up; the scheduling didn't flag it to me and I accept it should have. I'm content to sign. I'll drop the signed copy to you tomorrow.

Derek
